caption: The drawing depicts a vintage cash register positioned on a plain off-white background. The cash register is predominantly brown with golden-yellow decorative accents, including floral or urn motifs on its front-facing panels and sides. It has a rectangular shape with parallel vertical columns of numbered keys or buttons arranged in rows on its front, marked with silver-gray labels indicating monetary values. At the top center, there is a black and white display window showing "$ 000". The body of the cash register appears to be made of wood with metallic or brass-looking edges and trims. There is a single handle on the left side. The base of the cash register is broader and is adorned with matching decorative motifs. Four faded squares of tape residue, one near each corner, are visible on the background. The name "Joseph Piccavantl" is written in cursive in the lower right corner, along with "K.C. Mo."
title: Hume Cash Register
